preconditions.description: The total number of tasks is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
The total number of dependencies is between 0 and 10^5, inclusive.
Each task can only be executed on the main processor or the coprocessor.
Tasks are indexed from 0 to N - 1 and there are no circular dependencies.

postconditions.description: The output is the minimal number of coprocessor calls necessary to execute the program.
